evals.name: editable-onboarding-deck
evals.prompt: Turn these notes into a slide deck I can tweak myself before our team meeting — I'll want to move things around and fix wording. NOTES: Q3 onboarding revamp. Problem: new hires took ~6 weeks to first meaningful PR, too long. What we changed: a 2-week structured ramp, a buddy system, a checklist in Notion, weekly 1:1s. Results: time-to-first-PR down to 18 days, new-hire NPS up from 41 to 72, 0 regretted attrition in cohort. Next: roll out to the data team, add a mentorship track.
evals.expected_output: A single self-contained .html file: a data-driven deck (cover, problem, what-changed, results stats, next steps) using slide-forge layouts, with the in-file editor present (Edit button, overrides/freeObjects machinery), valid deck-data JSON, and present-mode byte-compatible structure.
assertions: In-file editor is present (Edit + forge runtime)
All slide layouts are valid registry names
Self-contained: no external CDN <script> at runtime

evals.name: draggable-4day-pitch
evals.prompt: make me a ~6 slide pitch on why our startup should adopt a 4-day work week, something I can drag things around in and recolor to match our brand later. punchy, not a wall of text.
evals.expected_output: A single self-contained editable .html deck (~6 slides) with varied structured layouts, short copy, the editor enabled so the user can drag/recolor afterward, valid deck-data JSON, a chosen theme applied.
assertions: In-file editor is present (Edit + forge runtime)
All slide layouts are valid registry names
Self-contained: no external CDN <script> at runtime
